tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Image and video models on KeelRouter with their USD prices per tier and the request params each accepts. Free to call.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image with a KeelRouter model. Spends real USD from the account balance at the price in list_models (from under $0.01 per image; higher resolutions cost more); failed calls are not charged. tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Start a video with a KeelRouter model and return task_id right away; videos take one to several minutes. Spends real USD from the account balance at the price in list_models (usually per second; check before choosing duration and resolution); failed calls are not charged. Then call get_result.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Status of an image or video task. When completed: file links and the final cost in USD.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: USD balance on this KeelRouter account.
